pheatmap Heatmap Layer Processor

Source: R/pheatmap_heatmap_layer_processor.R
PheatmapHeatmapLayerProcessor.Rd

Reads the one heat layer of a pheatmap from its drawn gtable.

Order. pheatmap() reorders the matrix by its trees (tree_row$order, tree_col$order) before drawing, and the gtable holds it in that order: the cells' fill matrix, the row and column labels. Its rows are top first, as maidr.js reads data.points.

Values. Each cell's value is, in order of preference:

  • exact: the matrix pheatmap() – maidr's wrapper – kept with the chart ("maidr_matrix"), the matrix as drawn;

  • otherwise the number printed in the cell, with display_numbers;

  • otherwise the middle of the legend band the cell's colour stands for, rounded to the band's width – with the default 100 colours, to a hundredth of the range drawn.

pheatmap::pheatmap() itself does not return its matrix, so a chart it drew directly has only the last two. Neither is exact, and the layer's title says which was used, as does a message (class maidr_pheatmap_values). A kept matrix or printed numbers are used only when each value lies in the legend band of its cell's colour, so numbers printed over the cells that are not their values – p-values, say – are not read as them.

Every source is the matrix as drawn, so with scale = "row" or "column" it is the scaled value (a z-score) the legend shows, not the input, and with kmeans_k the cluster centres. A cell drawn in na_col is a hole (null).

Selectors. The cells are one rect grob drawn column by column, each column top to bottom. Each is selected by its own id, in a grid whose rows run bottom first, as maidr.js's heat grid does.

PheatmapHeatmapLayerProcessor$labels()

The labels of one axis, in drawn order

The drawn labels when the axis shows them (labels_row, the k-means clusters' names); else the matrix's dimnames; else, as for an unnamed matrix, each row's or column's number in the input, in tree order.

Usage

PheatmapHeatmapLayerProcessor$labels(gt, name, dimnames, tree, count)

Arguments

gt

The gtable

name

"row_names" or "col_names"

dimnames

The fill matrix's names along the axis

tree

The axis' hclust, or NA when it was not clustered

count

The number of rows or columns drawn

Returns

Character vector
